title: Together, we make TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 unforgettable — thank you to our sponsors
description: TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 wouldn’t be what it is without the incredible companies that power the innovation behind the scenes.
author: Cindy Zackney

title: Less than 24 hours to spotlight your startup at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 in front of 10,000 tech leaders and VCs
description: You have less than 24 hours — and only a couple of tables left — to lock in the most valuable growth opportunity of the year at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Last flash sale before TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 doors open — save up to $624
description: Today is your last chance to save! Register for TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 before 11:59 p.m. PT tonight and save up to $624 on your pass. This is the lowest rate available before Disrupt hits San Francisco’s Moscone West on October 27-29. After today, prices rise.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: SK Telecom’s AI unit offers staff voluntary retirement program just weeks after launch
description: All staff employed by SK Telecom's new AI division are being offered a voluntary retirement program as part of a broader effort to bring together its various AI-related divisions, the company confirmed to TechCrunch.
author: Kate Park

title: Meta previews new parental controls for its AI experiences
description: Starting in the coming months, parents will be able to turn off chats with AI characters entirely for teens. This action won't block access to the Meta AI chatbot -- the company's general-purpose AI chatbot -- which will only discuss age-appropriate content.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Reddit expands its AI-powered search to 5 new languages
description: Users who have set one of these languages as their default, instead of English, can now chat with the AI in question-and-answer format.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI pauses Sora video generations of Martin Luther King Jr.
description: Sora's launch has stirred fervent public debate around the dangers of AI-generated videos and how platforms should implement guardrails around the technology.
author: Maxwell Zeff

title: Kayak launches an ‘AI Mode’ for travel questions, search, and bookings
description: Kayak is bringing AI directly to its main platform with a new “AI Mode” that lets travelers research, plan, and book trips through a built-in chatbot.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Why AI startups are taking data into their own hands
description: Where training sets were once scraped freely from the web or collected from low-paid annotators, companies are looking to proprietary training data as a competitive advantage.
author: Russell Brandom

title: The real reason Google DeepMind is working with a fusion energy startup
description: Google has invested in fusion startups as potential power suppliers. This latest move suggests Google sees them as potential customers, too.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Apple loses another AI exec to Meta
description: Yang’s departure marks the latest in a string of exits from Apple’s AI unit, putting the company into jeopardy in the lead-up to a much-anticipated Siri revamp scheduled for March.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Pinterest adds controls to let you  limit the amount of ‘AI slop’ in your feed
description: Pinterest is rolling out new controls that let users limit how much AI-generated content appears in their feeds. The company is also making its AI content labels more visible.
author: Sarah Perez
